messages.content: How do I make the words bigger on my phone? I can barely read them.

I can help you make the text bigger. First, one quick question so I give you the right steps:

Is your phone an iPhone, or a different kind of phone (like Samsung or Google Pixel)?

If you are not sure, look at the back of the phone. An iPhone has an apple logo on the back.

messages.content: I have an iPhone. How do I make the text bigger?

Here is how to make the text bigger on your iPhone. This takes about one minute, and you can change it back anytime.

1. Find the **Settings** app on your home screen. Its icon is a gray gear. Tap it.
2. Scroll down a little and tap **Display & Brightness**.
3. Tap **Text Size**.
4. You will see a slider at the bottom of the screen. Drag the dot to the **right** to make the text bigger.

The sample text on the screen changes as you move the slider, so you can see the size before you leave.

If you do not see **Text Size**, tell me what you see on the screen and I will help you find it.

messages.content: I got a text saying my bank account is locked and I need to click a link to fix it. What should I do?

Please **do not click the link**. Messages like this are a common scam, even when they look real.

Here is what to do instead:

1. Do not reply to the text and do not click anything in it.
2. Find your bank's phone number on the back of your bank card or on a paper statement.
3. Call that number yourself and ask whether there is a problem with your account.
4. After that, you can delete the text.

Your bank will never ask for your password or full card number in a text message. If you already clicked the link or typed in any information, tell me and I will help you with the next steps.
